evals.prompt: Set up SEO for my Next.js App Router project from scratch
evals.expected_output: Creates metadataBase in root layout, robots.ts, sitemap.ts, installs schema-dts, and configures title template
expectations: Sets metadataBase with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL env var in root layout
Creates app/robots.ts with production/staging differentiation
Creates app/sitemap.ts with static and dynamic page patterns
Configures title template in root layout metadata
Adds default description to root layout
Installs schema-dts as dev dependency
Does NOT install next-seo (deprecated)

evals.prompt: Add structured data to my blog posts with Article schema and breadcrumbs
evals.expected_output: Creates JSON-LD components with Article and BreadcrumbList schemas, type-safe with schema-dts
expectations: Creates a reusable JsonLd component with XSS sanitization (.replace(/</g, '\u003c'))
Creates schema factory functions using schema-dts types (WithContext<Article>)
Adds Article schema with headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, image
Adds BreadcrumbList schema with proper position numbering
Places sitewide schemas (Organization, WebSite) in root layout
Places page-specific schemas (Article, BreadcrumbList) in page component
Does NOT use FAQPage schema (restricted to gov/health since 2023)

evals.prompt: My product pages don't show rich results in Google. The Lighthouse SEO score is 72.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses missing Product structured data and meta tag issues, implements fixes
expectations: Checks for existing structured data (JSON-LD scripts)
Adds Product + Offer schema with price, currency, availability, sku
Verifies generateMetadata exports unique title and description per product
Checks for canonical URLs on product pages
Verifies OG image configuration (1200x630)
Checks heading hierarchy (single H1 per page)
Checks all images have alt text
Recommends validation via Google Rich Results Test

evals.prompt: Optimize my Next.js site for Core Web Vitals. LCP is 4.2s, CLS is 0.23
evals.expected_output: Identifies specific LCP and CLS issues and implements targeted fixes
expectations: Checks if LCP image has priority prop and sizes attribute
Verifies next/image is used instead of native img tags
Checks for AVIF/WebP format configuration in next.config
Verifies next/font usage (no external font requests causing CLS)
Checks all images have explicit width/height or fill prop
Looks for dynamic content injection above fold causing CLS
Does NOT reference FID (replaced by INP in 2024)
